test: TerraMind imagery-speed test, tile composite vs per-chip (registered 28 Nov 2026)

projection.note: tile cost scales with area (82 squares with parcels x 4 years, each a full 2,500 km2 square: an upper bound); per-chip with chips (160,000); same machine and session

notes.block_failures: 3 of 36 blocks failed at 13:34 when the cached Planetary Computer token expired during their reads (planetary_computer.sign reuses a cached token until it expires); retried with a fresh token and succeeded; their wasted reads are included in tile wall time, so the tile figure is slightly pessimistic. A full run must refresh the token when it is near expiry
notes.s1_differences: Sentinel-2 identical in all 16 chips. Sentinel-1: 9 of 16 chips identical in every pixel, the others differ on 0.2-1.3% of pixels, scattered, median 0.2 dB (max 5.5 dB). Likely cause (not tested): S1 RTC is resampled to the 10 m UTM grid and the nearest-neighbour pick can differ with the size of the read window; S2 is already on that grid. Both values are valid neighbour picks
notes.GB_decoded: decoded array size, not bytes transferred (registration said MB read)
notes.tile_deleted: the test tile and chips were deleted after the check, as registered
